choices.A: An obtuse angle is larger than a right angle
choices.B: An obtuse angle is smaller than a right angle
choices.C: An obtuse angle is a right angle

question: How does an obtuse angle compare with a right angle?
solution: An obtuse angle measures more than \(90^\circ\) and less than \(180^\circ\), while a right angle measures \(90^\circ\). Therefore, an obtuse angle is larger than a right angle, so the answer is A.
